main_text.l: piunt[?] provinciali: sin solius civitatis sunt, à

rios est comparatum, ut illi in biennium,

collegiü rerum maritimarum, quod Doc-
cumi nunc est, utraque pars è suis unum

cam gerendi potestatem à summo Gene-

page.notes: The first word "piunt" is hard to read at the line start; marked [?]. The first line reads "fin" in the scan, which is the long-s form of "sin", transcribed as s. The bracket after "locus" is a reference mark with no note text. The bottom-right stamp of the digitiser is left out. "Doccumi" and "Doccumano" are printed as they stand.
